findings.subject: u02
findings.title: Privileged membership lacks a current approval
findings.detail: No approved, unexpired request for this direct group membership was present in the snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Locate approval evidence or request an authorized access review; do not automatically revoke.

findings.subject: u05
findings.title: Approval was recorded after privileged access was granted
findings.recommendation: Verify emergency-access exception or investigate the sequence.

findings.subject: u03
findings.title: Disabled identity retains privileged membership
findings.detail: The identity is marked disabled but retains a direct privileged group membership.
findings.recommendation: Confirm current status and removal requirements with the application/group owner.

findings.subject: u04
findings.title: External access to sensitive SharePoint site lacks current approval
findings.detail: Guest/external identity has Read on a restricted site without a matching approved site request in the export.
findings.recommendation: Validate business sponsor, approved sharing exception and access necessity.

findings.subject: u05

findings.detail: No current approval has both a matching IGA approval_recorded event and SIEM membership_change event in this export.
findings.recommendation: Verify log coverage, retention, request-ID mapping and export completeness before treating this as a control failure.
